title: "Ayelan Ghareebi Da Kita Zahra Di Qabar Bana Ke Lyrics New 2025 Bibi Fatima Zahra Noha"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Noha"
poet: "Akbar"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

1
Ayelan Ghareebi Da Kita Zahra Di Qabar Bana Ke.
Payi Khak Ali Ne Walaan Te Sir Taun Dastar Hata Ke.
Piyo Dhi De Dukh Nayi Seh Sakda Kehya Zahra Nu Aye Haider.
Apne Babay De Naal Milein Toon Hath Pasay Taun Cha Ke.

2
Ainj Holay Holay Turda Hoya Ali Ghar Taein Wapis Aaya.
Baqiya Choon Jiwein Aaya Aye Do Lashaan Nu Dafna Ke.
Wehray Wich Dewa Baal Ke Aye Karey Wain Ali Haye Ghurbat.
Ummat Taun Qabar Chupawan Layi Aaya Nayi Charag Jala Ke.

3
Karda Aye Tilawat Raat Welay Zainab, Kulsoom Da Baba.
Dhiyaan Nal Ral Ke Ronda Aye Lailatul Qadar Te Aa Ke.
Har Matami Akbar Chahnda Aye Zahra Di Qabar Te Pursa.
Haye Bibi, Bibi Wain Karey Peshani Qabar Te La Ke.

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/ayelan-ghareebi-da-kita-zahra-di-qabar-bana-ke-lyrics-new-2025-bibi-fa-tajpoint-028c949af8da6436cc6c.md')
s = p.read_text()
_, meta, body = s.split('---')
roman = meta.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1]
for section, numbers in ((roman, '123'), (body, '۱۲۳')):
    lines = [line.strip() for line in section.splitlines() if line.strip()]
    assert len(lines) == 15
    assert ''.join(lines[::5]) == numbers
assert not re.search(r'[A-Za-z\\u200c]', body)
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed all 12 verses in Shahmukhi Punjabi and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Verified that both versions contain three numbered stanzas of four verses each.

Updated the language metadata to `Panjabi` (`pa-Arab`) based on the verses’ grammar and removed the missing-source tag. I read the ambiguous Roman `Baqiya` as `بقیع`. Only the selected Markdown file was edited.
